A tight list, whose items read as lines:

- one
- two
  - nested under two
- three

A loose list, whose items keep their paragraphs:

- one

- two

An ordered list that does not start at one:

3. third
4. fourth

Task items, ticked and not:

- [ ] open the window
- [x] close it

A list item holding more than a line:

- the first line

  and a paragraph under it
